audit.evidence: Posemo is a PostgreSQL monitoring framework, that can monitor everything in Postgres with an unprivileged user, which has no access to any data. Posemo conforms to the rules of the *German Federal Office for Information Security* (Bundesamt für Sicherheit in der Informationstechnik, BSI). It is built to check tens, hundreds or thousands of servers fast. ／ Posemo is a modular framework for creating monitoring checks for PostgreSQL. It is simple to add a new check. Usually you just have to write the SQL for the check and add some configuration. It is recommended to write some tests for every check. ／ Posemo is a modern Perl application using Moose; at installation it generates PostgreSQL functions for every check. These functions are called by an unprivileged user who can only call these functions, nothing else. But since they are `SECURITY DEFINER` functions, they run with more privileges (usually as superuser, and since PostgreSQL 10 as a user, which is member of `pg_monitor`). You need a superuser for installation, but checks can run (from remote or local) by an unprivileged user. Therefore, **the monitoring server need no access to your databases, no access to PostgreSQL internals; it can't change or read your data – it can only call some predefined functions.**

identity.one_liner: 阿拉伯语在线一对一辅导平台，Next.js+Laravel+WebRTC
identity.review: 一个面向中东地区的在线教育市场平台，连接学生/家长与认证教师，提供实时虚拟教室、自动预约与钱包托管分账。后端 Laravel 12 以 MySQL 8.0 承载 ACID 账本，Redis 做缓存与队列，前端 Next.js 15 Edge 渲染，媒体走 Agora 云。适合需要参考全栈在线教育系统搭建的开发者；依赖多项外部云服务（Agora、R2、Moyasar、OpenAI）。
highlights: 提供实时虚拟教室：Agora HD 视频、屏幕共享与 Netless 协作白板
实现基于 MySQL 行级锁的钱包托管账本与自动收益分成
内置 Filament 管理后台，含教师 KYC 审核与争议处理
use_cases: 一对一在线辅导平台的部署与二次开发
学习 Laravel + Next.js + WebRTC 全栈架构参考
学习钱包托管、预约调度与缓存优化的工程实现
